name: contract-preview-fixtures
goal: Generated test preview routes remain page-tier fixtures without polluting component catalog ownership

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: New component/layout preview routes inherited the scaffold molecule/layout composition tier and were cataloged as product pages. Full unit verification catches the molecule-to-molecule composition error.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Focused factory tests checked file emission and formatting but did not run registry composition. Strengthen the existing shell-kind integration case with explicit preview tier and absence of fixture entities; retain its single test and catalog assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Frozen existing shell-kind case fails on generated preview markup: it declares molecule instead of page. The full unit run independently rejects its molecule-to-molecule composition.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Choose atomic tier from each emitted route filename before applying the scaffold component level. Classify reserved generated __harness Svelte routes as test fixtures in default unit discovery, preserving their source imports and avoiding product catalog entities. Existing shell-kind registry checks are the durable guard.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Emitted +page routes receive page composition before scaffold-level overrides; generated reserved __harness Svelte routes are test fixtures in default unit discovery. Existing shell-kind and generator cases plus all missing-kernel failures now pass after building the kernel:28 tests in7files.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
